references.context: Category theory: binary product cone consisting of two arrows with common domain

references.phrase: for every object Z and arrows f,g a unique h exists
references.disposition: The uniqueness of the induced h commuting with both projections is the universal product property, not mere existence of P.

review_rationale: Reviewed a binary categorical product via its object P, two projection arrows, and unique mediating arrow for every pair of maps into X and Y. This is not necessarily Cartesian product of underlying sets.
